mission_amaranth_1: Tutorial. 22 Crawlmass over four waves; 18 was 100%/1 down, 25 was 16%/3 down — the turn-2 flank is the lesson and the cliff. Bot grinds 30+ turns; a human clears it in ~10.
mission_amaranth_2: Single door kept (briefing + mapsAmaranth.test.ts). Opening pair in the wire; three in the squad's face was 0/30. lost/run is the Munti dying in the room — watch it live.
mission_amaranth_3: Clear-bloom grind; the bot burns the mat one tile a turn (80-turn wins). Rate on cost, not on turns.
mission_amaranth_4: Three Undertow under the ruin, two between the ruin and the pads. Four/three was 0/30 at F-tier.
mission_amaranth_5: UNRATED BY BOT. Corked gap (Gallcyst + Undertow burrowed IN the gap); the Hard bot's danger bar will not walk five E-tier mechs into the acid box, so the escort never clears it (two Gallcyst: same; one Gallcyst and an open tile: 100%). Trace says feasible-tight. Needs a human. Gallcyst appears here, four missions before the story's M9 — flag.
mission_amaranth_6: First mech fight. Losses are commander_down; lost/run is the Munti dying first.
mission_amaranth_7: Hold on an open ridge ring: every hostile converges on the ring and on Rourke. One-unit cliff — this list is 72%, one more Crawlmass on the turn-2 flank is 0/50. Pre-rework it was 17%. Bot-fragile; play it.
mission_amaranth_9: Survive 10; rescue_pilot bonus. Bonus never attempted by the bot under pressure.
mission_amaranth_10: Extract through the walled compound; bonus patch. Extract band.
mission_amaranth_11: UNRATED BY BOT (same cork shape as W5, Undertow cork on Lask's only gap). Trace-rated feasible.
mission_amaranth_12: Act I finale hold. Commander-hunt losses; the ridge zone is the tile the whole Bloom converges on.
mission_amaranth_13: Two-lance debut (5 G recruits). Losses are long grinds; high downed.
mission_amaranth_15: Contested landing. Commander down in 49/50 — the landing puts Rourke in the open on turn 1; bot-inflated.
mission_amaranth_16: Garrison fight (17 conscripts + D-tier regulars). Pyrrhic: 7.7 down, 2.7 permanent per run.
mission_amaranth_17: UNRATED BY BOT. Three-tier descent, Gallcyst gaps, TL14. Bot never clears a cork. Trace-rated feasible-tight.
mission_amaranth_20: Mirror 1.5 C-tier + Marrow. 1.7 was 0/50 — mirror scale is a cliff, not a dial.
mission_amaranth_21: Bot never attacks the Wellroot/Gallcyst corks — TIMEOUT-dominated. Rate by trace: the fight itself is light.
mission_amaranth_23: Extract through the Accord's doors, TL 10, four Gallcyst in the doors. Escort discipline made this a walk for a 10-mech squad. Standard.
mission_amaranth_26: Extract with the immune-target rule: 'survive while Okafor walks'. Losses are the clock.
mission_amaranth_27: Hold that must end clean by 16: throughput-capped. 116 hostiles was 0/50, 58 was 62%.
mission_amaranth_28: 11.9 down per run — the most expensive brawl in the campaign.
mission_amaranth_29: East face of the blockhouse opened (one door was a fortress, 30/30). Body count capped ~50 so the hold can end clean.
mission_amaranth_31: Convoy (3 of N civilians): civilians are engine-driven fleeing AI, not bot. Rated by the engine's own herding.
mission_amaranth_33: Hold 16-22, throughput-capped and cliffed: 154 hostiles was 12%, 92 and 112 were 100%, 135 was 84%, 145 is this. One wave from either side.
mission_amaranth_35: The Unnamed spawned INSIDE the ring at 6 — scope flag. Throughput-capped hold.
mission_house_amaranth_2: Single door kept (briefing). Opening pair; three was 3%.
mission_house_amaranth_3: UNRATED BY BOT (same cork shape as W5, plus Marrow commander-hunt).
mission_house_amaranth_4: Marrow (Tank, move 3) is the commander: hostile focus-fire finds her. Every HA brawl carries this.
mission_house_amaranth_6: Commander-hunt (Marrow). 0/50 with 1.4 down — the losses are HER, not the squad.
mission_house_amaranth_11: Corked extract the Act II squad DOES get through: four Gallcyst (three was 94%, five was 0/50 commander-down). TL 9.
mission_house_amaranth_14: Extract TL 8 with four Gallcyst in the checkpoint. Cliff: three was 92%, five was 0/50 (timeouts) — the cork is binary, sealed or not. Left on the open side; the clock is the whole mission.
mission_house_amaranth_17: Double Gallcyst cork; the Act II squad shoots through it.
mission_house_amaranth_20: Withdrawal by design (Marrow extracts in 7). Wins cost 2.4 down.
mission_house_amaranth_22: Rear corners and Undertow inside the relay floor. Protect band.
mission_house_amaranth_23: Wellroot moved to (14,4) so its acid covers the ring's east half. Eight Choir at 1 was a wall (0/20).
mission_house_amaranth_24: The Governor is a civilian and can be shot. Extract band.
mission_house_amaranth_26: BLOOM SCALING. Sixty Bloom units incl. a ring of twenty Bramble three tiles out and four Choir: Hard 100% at ~1 down. An Act III squad (15 mechs, 5 A-tier, three Screens, Meeps ambush) is a meat grinder for Bloom melee; a Bramble does ~30 to an A-tier frame and dies to three hits. Data Pack question, not a mission one.
mission_house_amaranth_28: Alpha-strike coin flip: 25 A-tier Warden mechs, whoever lands first wins; wins cost 3.9 down, 1.1 permanent.
mission_house_amaranth_29: Hold vs tiered mechs; 8 B at 1 was 6%, 6 B is ~58%.
mission_house_amaranth_31: Convoy (3 of 6): losses are civilians wandering into the clock, not combat.
mission_house_amaranth_32: Pads moved to the dock's west face. Protect band.
